worst_moment: "The speed is 20 m/s, but only part of it goes up. Think of a 30-60-90 triangle: at 60 degrees, the vertical part is 20 times sin(60)." - repeats the claim and hands over the formula without ever explaining why the vertical speed is less (e.g. a horizontal throw has none).
best_moment: "Imagine a ball launched straight up at 20 m/s. How long until it returns? Then think how the angle changes that." - a reasonable attempt to build from the student's own picture.
